subject.title: fix(mxc): bound sandbox policy file reads to prevent OOM

question: Should MXC reject existing configured sandbox-policy files above 1 MiB on upgrade in exchange for guaranteed bounded policy-loading memory use?
rationale: The implementation deliberately changes acceptance of an existing operator-controlled input; source and proof establish behavior, but they cannot determine the intended upgrade contract.

options.title: Accept the 1 MiB ceiling
options.body: Merge the current bounded-read behavior and document the operational expectation that policy files must remain at or below 1 MiB.

options.title: Choose a different compatibility contract
options.body: Keep the hardening goal but direct a different size ceiling or an explicit migration/operator-warning path before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept the 1 MiB ceiling
recommendation.body: Merge the current bounded-read behavior and document the operational expectation that policy files must remain at or below 1 MiB.

likelyOwner.reason: They implemented and documented the current MXC policy-loading behavior and can provide the technical context while an MXC-area reviewer makes the product decision.
